subject: maths
question: In how much time will ₹6,25,000 become ₹8,31,875 at 10% per annum, compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs 6,25,000 

Amount = Principal + CI = Rs 8,31,875 

r = 10% per annum

**Formula used:**

In compound interest,

Amount = Principal × (1 + r / 100)n

**Calculation:**

Let, n be the number of years.

According to the question,

⇒ 8,31,875 = 62500 0× (1 + 10 / 100)ⁿ .

⇒ 8,31,875 / 625000 = (11 /10)ⁿ 

​⇒ 1331 / 1000 = (11 /10)n 

​⇒ (11 /10)³ = (11 /10)n .

⇒ n = 3 years

**∴ The time will be 3 years.**
